commit.message:
test(#1342 r4): kiem "da signaled" cho co han 5 s; J9 lay mau ActiveProcesses ngay sau khi ham nem (dac ta ban 13)

Do native Desktop tren 728ecca (phien dieu phoi): J3 va J9 do 10/10 vi
WaitForSingleObject(h, 0) tra 258 ngay khi ham tra, cho them thi signaled sau
duoi 50 micro-giay — doi tuong tien trinh chuyen signaled SAU luc job bao
ActiveProcesses == 0. Dac ta ban 13 (sha256 f435eb5c...) Q7/Q9:
- J2, J3, J8, J9: phep kiem "da signaled" sau khi ham tra/nem cho toi 5000 ms.
- J9: doc va LUU ActiveProcesses qua ban sao job ngay sau khi ham nem; cham
  tien trinh phu (nhan k2) roi con; sau cung moi assert mau da luu.
Khong doi ma san pham. Khong them dong: 376 dong them cua tep test giu nguyen.

Chua do tren Windows: phan sua nay moi do tren Linux (cac ca native BO QUA).
